title: City Council District 2
statement: I support the progress made on the Baylight District remediation. The completion of soil test verification and the commencement of Phase II remediation with independent oversight are crucial steps. However, I remain concerned about the commercial decay in Jack London and Downtown. We need to ensure that the growth in one area doesn't overshadow the struggles in another. I will continue to push for targeted support for Downtown and Jack London, addressing both economic imbalance and safety concerns.

payload.text: I certify the Phase II site remediation schedule for the Baylight District (INIT-006) and acknowledge the need to address commercial decay in Jack London and Downtown.
